Raven Memory

Version 1.0.0

- Introduces persistent causal memory for AI agents, recording all actions as a causally-linked chain.
- Enables recall of relevant history using semantic search and supports rollback, branching, and parallel task tracking.
- Stores data locally by default in an encrypted (optional) database.
- Provides tools for session management, event recording, semantic search, rollback, and health check.
- Designed local-first for privacy and persistence, with easy Python and skill installation.
